evidence.detail: Removes winner and record columns from matchrow.mustache and matchtable.mustache UI, but explicitly leaves db schema and SQLAlchemy model in place
winner_id column still defined in Game model
insert_game() never sets winner_id — column is always NULL because PDBot does not yet report it

triage.notes: Issue is 7 years old (2019). The SQLAlchemy/db plumbing is intentionally preserved awaiting PDBot integration; silasary's 2019 comment confirms this is a PDBot-side dependency, not a pure decksite change.
